notes.title: Update + More Fixes
notes.content:
In an effort to keep up with the latest hardware (aka 64 bit), we have posted a new version up compiled with the best and most compatible tools. I also snuck in some fixes for the Settings menu that people have been asking for.

I am still working on adding a joystick control that is fun. The problem is that a joystick is a lot less precise when compared to a mouse. But be assured that I am listening and working on it. As soon as I have anything that is fun, I will post it.
